TAKE IT TO THE BIG SCREEN

One screen. Whole gym.

Put your device and compatible TV on the same Wi-Fi network. Gym guest networks may block TV discovery. Connect your device to the TV, then select TV display for a clean view.

  1. iPhone / iPadUse Control Center → Screen Mirroring, then choose an AirPlay-compatible TV.
  2. AndroidUse your phone’s Screen Cast / Smart View feature with a compatible TV or receiver. Availability varies by phone.
  3. Laptop / desktopIn Chrome, open the browser menu → Cast, save and share → Cast, then cast this tab. An HDMI cable works too.

Mirroring shows your phone’s screen, including controls when you leave TV display. A laptop’s separate display window can stay clean while you edit in the other window. For separate phone controls, choose Connect TV & phone. Open the paired display page on the TV or a laptop and use the phone remote. The remote supports tap and swipe scoring.

Keep the app open and your device unlocked. Your TV and device must support the chosen casting method. Sound depends on your device’s audio output.
